items.title: Who pays the agency
items.text: The landlord's agency often charges you too: commonly a month's rent, or a share of the yearly rent, plus VAT. We ask for the figure in writing before the viewing.

items.title: Which contract
items.text: A 4+4 at a rent set freely. A 3+2 within the bands of Milan's local agreement. A transitorio, up to 18 months, only with a documented reason. We check which one you are handed.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: At most three months' rent, by law, and the landlord owes you legal interest on it every year. We check the clause before you sign.

items.title: What the rent covers
items.text: Condominium charges, heating, utilities: what is in the rent, and what is not. We ask for the answer in writing before you sign.

items.title: Registration
items.text: The lease must be registered within 30 days of signing, or of the start if earlier. Until it is registered, the lease is void under Italian law: a weak title for your residence. We ask for the receipt.

items.title: Residence
items.text: Codice fiscale first. Then report your Milan address to the Anagrafe within 20 days of moving in, with the lease in hand. We check the lease is in your name, at that address.

items.q: Doesn't the landlord's agency charge me too in Italy?
items.a: Often, yes: commonly a month's rent or a share of the yearly rent, plus VAT. Italian law sets no tariff, so get the figure in writing before the viewing; on our searches, we ask for it. BOOM Milan is a separate agent you hire: a flat fee, paid by you only, never by landlords.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, in English or Italian, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

items.q: Which contract will a student get in Milan?
items.a: There is a lease made for it: the student lease, 6 to 36 months, for students enrolled at a university away from home, rent within the bands of Milan's local agreement. You may be handed a transitorio or a 4+4 instead. We check which one it is, and that it gets registered.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Milan from abroad?
items.a: The usual pattern: stolen photos, a price below the market, an owner 'abroad' who cannot show the flat, a deposit to 'block' the room, then silence. Never pay before someone on your side has seen the flat. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report; with Full Search or Application Pack we also check the lease before you sign.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the €500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.

items.q: Is BOOM Milan a real estate agency?
items.a: Yes. BOOM Milan is a desk of Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., an Italian real estate agency registered with the Rome Chamber of Commerce (REA RM-1710623), under the same Italian law as our agency in Rome. On this desk we work for the tenant only: you hire us and pay us, never the landlord.
